agents.name: Receptionist
agents.description: Handle incoming calls, route callers to the right specialist, and answer frequent questions — in Arabic and English.

preview.en: Good morning. How can I direct your call?
preview.ar: صباح الخير. كيف يمكنني توجيه مكالمتك؟

agents.name: Appointment Setter
agents.description: Schedule meetings, confirm availability, and send the caller a clear next step.

preview.en: Tuesday at 11:00 is open. Shall I book it?
preview.ar: الثلاثاء الساعة 11 متاح. هل أحجز الموعد؟

agents.name: Lead Qualification
agents.tagline: Screen, score, and hand off ready leads.
agents.description: Ask the right questions, capture requirements, and pass qualified prospects into CRM.

preview.en: What size is the team, and what should we solve first?
preview.ar: ما حجم الفريق، وما التحدي الأهم لديكم؟

agents.name: Survey & Feedback
agents.description: Run surveys and collect feedback as a conversation, then store structured responses.

preview.en: On a scale of one to five, how was today's visit?
preview.ar: من واحد إلى خمسة، كيف تقيّم زيارتكم اليوم؟

agents.name: Customer Service
agents.description: Resolve common issues, answer account questions, and escalate exceptions with context.

preview.en: I can check that request and open a ticket if it needs a specialist.
preview.ar: يمكنني متابعة الطلب وفتح تذكرة إذا احتجتم مختصاً.

agents.name: Custom Agent
agents.tagline: A voice agent designed around your process.
agents.description: Define the role, knowledge, workflow, and business actions — then connect the agent to your applications.

preview.en: Tell us the conversation you want handled. We'll design the agent around it.
preview.ar: صفوا لنا المحادثة المطلوبة. نصمّم الوكيل وفقاً لها.
